title: A Theory of Finite-Noise Optima and Generalization in Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Quantum noise is expected to degrade quantum machine learning by driving circuits away from their noiseless implementations. Yet recent studies show moderate noise can reduce testing error, a behavior unexplained by weak-noise perturbative error accumulation or strong-noise trainability collapse. Here we develop a statistical learning theory connecting microscopic noise processes to macroscopic learning performance.
